title: Scrub categories
description: Demo scrub catalog consumed by agent-gateway ScrubCatalog.from_bundle. Each category has a name, a severity class (pii|secret|codeword) that selects tokenize-vs-redact, and ECMA-262 regex backstops applied after schema-annotation detection. PII categories cover the customer fields agent-sql-mcp returns (lookup_customer / search_customer / get_order / list_orders); secret/codeword categories are the broadened-scrub backstops.

categories.name: NAME
categories.description: Person names (customer.name and free-text references to people). Detection via Presidio's SpacyRecognizer mapped through ScrubEngine.PRESIDIO_MAP[PERSON]; no regex backstop because person names don't admit a useful pattern.

categories.name: ADDRESS
categories.description: Postal/physical addresses (customer.address and free-text mentions). Detection via Presidio's location recognizer mapped through ScrubEngine.PRESIDIO_MAP[LOCATION]; no regex backstop.

categories.name: CODEWORD_PROJECT
categories.description: Demo project codewords that must never leave the boundary.
